$comment: Pulse /schema input_schema for an operator AFE cover letter (joint-interest owner copy). JSON Schema, nested depth <= 3. Field names match truth/synth/afe_cover.json so the scorer needs no mapping. SYNTHETIC demonstration corpus.

letter_date.description: Date printed at the top of the letter, exactly as printed (do not reformat).

operator_name.description: Name of the operator sending the letter, from the letterhead or signature block, exactly as printed.

addressee.description: Name of the working-interest owner the letter is addressed to, exactly as printed.

afe_number.description: AFE number referenced in the letter, exactly as printed including any prefix and hyphens.

well_name.description: Well name referenced in the letter, exactly as printed.

response_due_date.description: Date by which the owner must return the election, exactly as printed. Null if the letter states no due date.

wi_decimal_stated.description: The owner's working-interest decimal as printed in this letter, six decimal places. Copy the printed decimal; never convert from a percentage and never recompute.

net_share_stated.description: The owner's net dollar share of the AFE estimate as printed in this letter. Digits only, no currency symbol or thousands separators.
